purpose: Freeze the terminal live-Hermes proof before generation 1. This commit is preregistration and control instrumentation, not the live result.
post_merge: Pull main, install/authenticate real Hermes with persistent HERMES_HOME, then run the frozen controller. Do not show Hermes the objective before this preregistration is merged.
release_rule: If HERMES-LIVE-001 passes, freeze Nightshift and move to packaging. NIGHTSHIFT-002 exists only for a defect exposed by the live run.
